input_contract.length_type: size_t; signed 32-bit positions limit <= INT32_MAX bytes

lifecycle_contract.output_bound: max(1,inputLength); the extra empty byte is capacity, not stored bytes
lifecycle_contract.return_length: vendor returned length, exact 0-byte finalized suffix
lifecycle_contract.error_codes: tscb_status_v1; strict prechecks before SIMD vendor entry
lifecycle_contract.finalize: REQUIRED_NOOP_ONE_SHOT_FINALIZE; tail already completed in compress
lifecycle_contract.reset: NEW_OPTIMAL_CONTEXT_PER_INDEPENDENT_OBJECT; ABI reset clears timers and state

stream_components.outer_container: 12-byte unique LZSSE8 prefix + canonical JSON dtype/shape/name/logical length/track descriptors, all charged
stream_components.raw_mode: Intrinsic vendor raw storage if encoded length equals decoded length, including empty/short inputs; not another codec fallback
stream_components.compressed_mode: 8 initial literals, 16-byte nibble controls, XOR literals or differential 16-bit offsets, carried match lengths, 16 final literals
stream_components.decode_validation: Independent control/offset/length traversal checks every unconditional SIMD 16-byte load/store and exact input/output tail; then original SIMD decoder
stream_components.accounting: Opaque complete raw or compressed bytes attributed to the selected Track, prefix/container and descriptor/metadata disjoint; no uncharged external side information

known_limitations: Explicit user LZSSE8 request authorizes this specific extra variant; spreadsheet LZSS is alexkazik/lzss and remains a separate algorithm. Existing unfinished LZSSE2 is preserved, not qualified or substituted.
LZSSE8 Optimal Parse only, registered fixed level12, x64 SSE4.1, single thread, no scalar or Fast fallback. Upstream header supports levels1..17 but other levels are not registered.

No dedicated upstream LZSSE tests are present in the local lzbench closure. Project suites are labeled as project tests, not fabricated upstream suites; 44 direct unmodified-source comparisons prove patch bitstream compatibility on the retained corpus.

Vendor files remain byte-identical. Build-time hashed patch fixes null allocation/free, unaligned integer accesses using memcpy, and out-of-object safe-end pointer formation without changing the parser or format.

Native API timing excludes state allocation/free and structural stream validation; CORE includes these internal wrapper operations and Python descriptor/FFI/copies. Mandatory Finalize emits zero bytes and adds no native API time.
No checksum: structurally valid corruption may decode; common bit-exact validation remains mandatory. Empty/short/incompressible inputs can legitimately use vendor raw mode.
ASan/UBSan covers patched codec and C ABI; exact guard-backed buffer tests have no external safe-overread padding. LeakSanitizer disabled under host ptrace policy.

One complete stream per routed object, full-matrix byte view preserves all IEEE payloads. block_size controls framework boundary fixtures, not an implicit segmentation stage. Streaming/query/random-access are unsupported.

Decoded byte work limit is INT32_MAX; allocation also depends on large optimal state and per-byte Arrival storage. Worker memory limit may produce OOM rather than claiming all theoretical lengths fit physical RAM.
